serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
In accordance with FedRAMP Policy this service offering lost it's only authorizing agency and has been moved to FedRAMP Ready status for 12 months until a new agency provides an ATO.

This service offering has a complete FedRAMP security package at the Li-SaaS impact level that can be leveraged for review and reuse. This service was previously FedRAMP Authorized and will regain its FedRAMP Authorized status once an agency issues an ATO following FedRAMP’s Quick Guide for Reuse. If an ATO is not issued within one year of the FedRAMP Ready Date the service offering will be removed from the FedRAMP Marketplace. Please feel free to contact the PMO at info@fedramp.gov if you have any questions. 

Esper’s suite of policy collaboration and workflow tools are purpose-built for government agencies across the United States. Our cloud-based, SaaS platform allows for data-driven research, collaborative policymaking & stakeholder review and public-facing engagement on the policies that impact citizens directly.
Our platform allows policymakers to:
- Streamline internal workflows on policy
- Repeal, update and draft all forms of policy
- Track progress on policies with real-time reports
- Analyze data to help assess the policy landscape
- Collect feedback and data from impacted stakeholders"Our platform allows policymakers to:
